On a light system the text on the photo takes the system's page colour (its light) and the ground behind the photo the system's text colour, so the text stays light on the photo and the probe, which judges it against that ground, sees the pair a reader sees; the round header buttons keep their own icon. Fonts, sizes and the button follow on both sides. Other layouts are not one-screen and follow as drafted.
